- SE or Viewer attempts create/update/archive: 403 Forbidden
- Unsafe request without valid CSRF token: 403 CSRF_FAILURE
- Active PM creating a project always becomes its PM
- Active Admin creating a project must explicitly assign
an active PM; Admin does not become the PM itself
- Only Admin or the owning PM may update, archive, or
- SE / Viewer may hold explicit project membership for
read access only; they cannot manage projects or sites
- Project DELETE archives (soft delete); Site DELETE
- Project and Site audit events are written synchronously
